t: You're on Malet Street, in Bloomsbury, in the London Borough of Camden. It runs between Torrington Place and the British Museum, parallel to Gower Street and Tottenham Court Road. The street takes its name from Sir Edward Malet, a British diplomat who held the title of fourth Baronet. That's all the detail I have on the connection, but it's a quiet reminder that many London streets carry the names of people from the public life of their day.
